calls.statement:
WITH rc AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, s.format, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) q
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT format, staff, count(*) receipts, round(avg(net),2) avg_net, round(avg(gross),2) avg_gross, round(median(net),2) med, max(net) mx, round(quantile_cont(net,0.99),2) p99, avg(lines) al, count(distinct store_id) stores
FROM rc GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_name, count(*) lines, sum(net_amount) net, max(net_amount) maxline, max(quantity) maxq, bool_or(staff_purchase_flag) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 12

WITH receipts AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, s.format AS store_format,
         sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net,
         bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS any_staff, bool_and(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS all_staff
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, s.format
)
SELECT store_format, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT any_staff) AS receipts_excl_staff,
  round(avg(receipt_net) FILTER (WHERE NOT any_staff), 2) AS avg_basket_excl_staff,
  round(avg(receipt_net), 2) AS avg_basket_incl_staff,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE any_staff <> all_staff) AS mixed
FROM receipts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
